title: Shapeshifters Symposium: Plasticity – Here, There, and Everywhere
speaker: Keynotes: Heleen Slagter (VU Amsterdam), Maurizio Meloni (Deakin University), Zakiyyah Iman Jackson (Duke University), Suparna Choudhury (McGill University)
location: Day 1: Museum Speelklok; days 2 and 3: Universiteitsmuseum Utrecht
description: Interdisciplinary symposium on plasticity (STS, Black studies, cognitive neuroscience, cultural analysis, plant science and more), organised by the Communicating Plasticity consortium (UU, UMC Utrecht, TU/e, Wageningen). Thu and Fri talks and panels 09:00-17:00, Sat workshop 10:00-13:00. Registration required. RMA students and PhD candidates affiliated with a Dutch humanities research school can earn 1 EC (NICA) by attending Thursday and Friday.
